# Bundled third-party installers

## BlackHole 2ch 0.7.1

`BlackHole2ch-0.7.1.pkg` is the unmodified, signed and notarised installer
from Existential Audio (https://existential.audio/blackhole/). Beatrice runs
it on first launch when BlackHole is missing, so other apps can hear the
converted voice.

BlackHole is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Its source
code is at https://github.com/ExistentialAudio/BlackHole (tag v0.7.1).
